integration_cpu.environment: GitHub windows-latest (no GPU); packaged 2d2vr180-cli.exe; runtimes installed by bundled uv; models downloaded by the model manager with pinned SHA256 verified
integration_cpu.input: NASA astronaut photo (public domain, via scikit-image) and a synthetic fixed-camera video with a moving object
integration_cpu.video_runtime: recon3d-cu124 installed + imports OK (training needs CUDA: not run)

rc5_multiview_runtime.result: pass: runtime installed with bundled uv on windows-latest; VGGT-1B and MoGe-2 ViT-L downloaded through the model manager (pinned SHA256); multi-view worker pose stage on CPU: 3 views, 393k init points, metric scale factor 1.40, camera yaw 0 / 0.78 / 1.62 deg (correct direction). gsplat training needs CUDA: not run.

rc5_generative_runtime.result: pass: runtime installed (stable-virtual-camera package copied from the pinned commit archive after its packaging bug was found by the first run); LaMa downloaded and run on CPU (hole filled with plausible content); seva modules import and trajectories build. Stable Virtual Camera weights are gated (need a user token): generation not run.

rc5_photo_runtime.result: pass: photo runtime install, model downloads and all real CPU photo/fixed-camera-video runs (incl. gravity levelling and the LaMa fallback path) succeeded on windows-latest.
